newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Tyumen Oil '96 output slips to 21.3 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Russian Tyumen Oil '96 output slips to 21.3 mln T.

text.p: Russia's Tyumen Oil Company produced 21.30 million tonnes (426,000 barrels per day) of oil in 1996, six percent down on the 22.57 million tonnes it produced in 1995, the company's press service said on Wednesday.
It said the firm's Ryazan refinery processed 4.15 million tonnes of crude oil in 1996, only half the planned total.
Tyumenskaya Neftyanyaya Kompaniya refined 7.39 million tonnes of oil in 1995.
Its main crude oil production unit is AO Nizhnevartovskneftegaz.
This year, the company, headed former Fuel and Energy Minister Yuri Shafranik, plans to produce 20.13 million tonnes of crude and refine 7.5 million tonnes.
It also plans to reconstruct its Ryazan refinery and build 12 gasoline filling stations built to Western standards in the Tyumen, Ryazan and Orlovsk regions.
Tyumen is one of Russia's dozen or so vertically-integrated oil companies.
